records.geogcomments: on the Hanson Ranch, Roxson, WY. Includes five quarries from the same bonebed: North (N), South (S), Southeast (SE), West (W), and Teague (T) plus three exploratory quarries to determine extent: Toe, Neufeld (Neu), and DKC.
records.primary_reference: K. Derstler. 1995. The Dragons' Grave: an Edmontosaurus bonebed containing theropod egg shells and juveniles, Lance Formation (uppermost Cretaceous), Niobrara County, Wyoming. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 15(3, suppl.):26A
